pages.title: About Postman
pages.text:
About Postman
Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. Postman simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so you can create better APIs—faster.
The founders
Postman started simply as a side project to solve a specific problem: Abhinav Asthana, Postman's CEO and co-founder, set out to create a tool that would simplify the API testing process. As the tool's usage quickly exploded, Abhinav recruited two of his former colleagues, Ankit Sobti and Abhijit Kane, to help him create Postman, Inc. Postman is now the world's leading API platform, and the three founders still lead the company to this day.
(Photo caption from left to right, Ankit Sobti, Abhinav Asthana, and Abhijit Kane).
Our values
At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication. We love to hear about our successes, but we value and appreciate the opportunity to learn and grow from each other's mistakes.
Create with curiosity
We repeatedly ask, “Why?” and challenge best practices. Asking “Why?” and “Why not?” is how we start each experimental journey, with a willingness to fail until we succeed. At Postman, no star is too far to shoot for.
Earn trust
We seek input first and listen before taking action. We're always open to perspectives because a diversity of thought and discussion improves our chances of discovering the best solutions.
Embrace constraints
We see constraints as an opportunity to be creative and resourceful with the people and tools we have available to us.
Win together
We count on each other, always offer help, and focus on solutions. We are a hybrid workplace spanning the globe, but Postmanauts are part of a tight, trusting community that appreciates each person's contributions toward Postman's mission.
Own & deliver
We learn from our mistakes and adapt with ease. We push ourselves to take bold but smart risks, and we celebrate failures for the learnings we gain as a result.
The Postman API Platform
The Postman API Platform delivers high productivity for developers, great quality for APIs, and airtight governance for organizations across the world.
Customer stories
See a wide selection of detailed use cases from nearly every industry on the Postman customer stories page.
500,000 companies use Postman
Many of the world's top organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500, are using the Postman API Platform today.
The investors
Postman recently closed a $225 million Series D investment round led by existing investor Insight Partners, and joined by new investors Coatue, Battery Ventures, and BOND, along with existing investors CRV and Nexus Venture Partners.
Our offices
We're a global company headquartered in San Francisco—with offices in Bangalore (where the company was founded) and Japan—and distributed team members on multiple continents.

Postman description
Postman is the leading collaboration platform for API-development, used by more than 40 million users and 500,000 companies worldwide. Postman is an elegant, flexible environment used to build connected software via APIs, quickly, easily and accurately. Postman is headquartered in San Francisco and has an office in Bangalore, where it was founded.
Abhinav Asthana
CEO/Co-Founder
Abhinav is a developer and entrepreneur who began his career at Yahoo. He started Postman as a side project as he grappled with the complexity of connecting disparate pieces of software via APIs. Existing API tools were primitive, especially when it came to testing and debugging. This inspired Abhinav to create the free Postman app, which quickly drew 500,000 developers with no marketing. Joined by two former workmates, Abhinav launched Postman Inc. in 2014. Today, Postman's API Platform has more than 40 million users worldwide and is spearheading the API-first approach to software development. Abhinav holds a B.E. (with honors) from India's Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani. Outside of work, Abhinav can be found spending time with his family, reading several books at once, or exploring the newest release on PlayStation 5.
Ankit Sobti
CTO/Co-Founder
Ankit started his career in engineering roles at Adobe and Yahoo, where he met future Postman co-founder Abhinav. Together, they discovered the power of APIs, as well as the problems that could arise from a lack of effective tooling. This shortcoming spurred Ankit to help found Postman Inc. Ankit has experience in product, business, and development and now leads the core technology group at Postman. He has a B.E. from India's Netaji Subhas University of Technology, as well as an MBA from the Indian School of Business. Ankit is a Chelsea football club supporter and loves his piano, books, beers, and bacon.
Abhijit Kane
Product Architect/Co-Founder
Abhijit is a software engineer who began his career at Adobe, Walmart, and TeliportMe, which was Postman co-founder Abhinav's first startup. They were part of a small team building a complex API and needed to share information throughout the development cycle. During this time, usage of the Postman app exploded, and Abhijit joined Abhinav and Ankit in creating Postman Inc. Abhijit holds a B.E. (with honors) from India's Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani. He loves to read in his spare time and is learning to play the piano. Abhijit has been known to show up at work wearing a swimming cap after an absent-minded commute.

pages.title: Careers | Postman
pages.text:
Become a Postmanaut!
Join a global community on a mission to help build an API-first world.
Join us
We are a hybrid workplace and diversity-focused company. We hire and retain the best talent from around the globe by reaching a wide breadth of communities and tapping nontraditional paths to find our ideal teammates.
At Postman, we offer a carefully curated blend of world-class benefits so that you can maintain a healthy work-life balance and peace of mind. Your loved ones will thank you for joining us!
Our values
At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication. We love to hear about our successes, but we value and appreciate the opportunity to learn and grow from each other's mistakes.
Create with curiosity
We repeatedly ask, “Why?” and challenge best practices. Asking “Why?” and “Why not?” is how we start each experimental journey, with a willingness to fail until we succeed. At Postman, no star is too far to shoot for.
Earn trust
We seek input first and listen before taking action. We're always open to perspectives because a diversity of thought and discussion improves our chances of discovering the best solutions.
Embrace constraints
We see constraints as an opportunity to be creative and resourceful with the people and tools we have available to us.
Win together
We count on each other, always offer help, and focus on solutions. We are a hybrid workplace spanning the globe, but Postmanauts are part of a tight, trusting community that appreciates each person's contributions toward Postman's mission.
Own & deliver
We learn from our mistakes and adapt with ease. We push ourselves to take bold but smart risks, and we celebrate failures for the learnings we gain as a result.
Equal opportunity
At Postman, diversity means we implement informed policies and practices to grow a company that reflects global experiences and identities while treating each person with fairness and dignity.
Inclusion is the choice we make each day and with every interaction, to foster a workplace and world where people of all backgrounds not only belong but excel. We understand that together, we succeed better.
Postman is unapologetically committed to Equal Opportunity Employment. We proudly offer equal employment opportunities to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.
If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodations through the hiring process, please let us know early by emailing us here. We want to give you every opportunity to show us the star that you are.
Benefits and perks
Our generous benefits package reflects our values and our deep appreciation for our employees. We're committed to supporting the well-being of all Postmanauts and their families. The philosophy around our benefits is the same globally, and may vary to follow local guidelines and cultural preferences.
Health care
Based on where you're located and the plans available there, you can have up to 100% of your and your family's premium costs covered by Postman, or receive a generous monthly allowance to supplement existing medical coverage.
Unlimited PTO
All full-time Postman employees have unlimited paid time off (PTO). We strongly encourage everyone to exercise this benefit to ensure that personal and work lives remain well-balanced, healthy, and fully charged. Your body, mind, spirit, and loved ones will appreciate it!
Supporting healthy meals
We want to ensure you eat healthy each day. It's why we provide a taxable monthly stipend so that you can be nourished throughout the week.
Play well, be well
We're serious about your wellness. Whether it's a boxing club membership, hula classes, or a longboard, we're here to cheer you on to get out and get moving. We'll reimburse you for activities and items that bring you joy through our wellness and fitness program.
Career development
We support your career development by providing access to unlimited courses on Udemy and a book allowance. Enhance and uplevel your skills, and even learn something completely new!
Postman off-sites
Postman off-sites bring our global team together to share unforgettable memories in inspiring locations. From our first company trip to Barcelona, these bonding events combine professional growth with cultural experiences unique to each city—strengthening team connection, curiosity, and innovation.
Postmanaut Giving Program
Community giving is at the core of our DNA. With the Postmanaut Giving Program, Postman supports your philanthropic efforts by matching your monetary contributions and volunteer hours to eligible organizations of your choice. Your cause is Postman's cause.
Awards
While we're proudest of our customer success stories, who doesn't appreciate hard-earned outside recognition? Join us and help grow our list of global achievements like the ones below:
100 Most Loved Workplaces
Best Practice Institute, 2021
Forbes Cloud 100
Forbes, 2022
India's Best Workplaces for Women 2021
Great Place to Work, 2021
